title: Define the build-manifest and build-report contracts
description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/build-manifest.schema.json (required schema_version/project/tasks; each task requires id + status enum pending|done|skipped, with files array and reason string) and build-report.schema.json (required schema_version/project/generated_at/tasks_total/tasks_done/tasks_skipped/files_touched; counts integer minimum 0; additionalProperties false). Add validateBuildManifest/validateBuildReport to cli/lib/validate.js and register both schema names in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: Both schemas exist under contracts/schemas/v1 and load via the existing validator.
validateBuildManifest and validateBuildReport are exported and tested (valid + invalid cases).
doctor still passes with both new schema names registered.
